99:t_1:5.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The observation data also leaves little doubt that the red-sea world... the world where $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ and the Angels existed, vanished in the transfer.」

99:t_1:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「$$ＮＥＲＶ$$... EVA... Angels... So they vanished before we ever understood anything about them...」

99:t_1:7.en:
$$レイアム$$
「But if the phenomenon centered on EVA Unit-01 had continued...」

99:t_1:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「It might have destroyed the entire world... There was something about it that made me think so.」

99:t_1:9.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I understand that world suffered two disasters like that on a global scale in the past.」

99:t_1:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「Then that was the third... In other words, $$サードインパクト$$...」

99:t_1:11.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I hear $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ was fighting the Angels to prevent it.」

99:t_1:12.en:
$$オットー$$
「At any rate, thanks to the $$時空震動$$, the world escaped destruction.」

99:t_1:13.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I wonder if the spear-shaped object that flew in then caused it...」

99:t_1:14.en:
$$オットー$$
「We have no way of knowing now. ...If a $$時空震動$$ had to happen, I wish it had sent the $$新地球皇国$$ away.」

99:t_1:16.en:
$$オットー$$
「I know. I don't intend to rely on accidents or tricks like a $$時空震動$$.」

99:t_1:17.en:
$$オットー$$
「We'll break through this situation with our own strength.」

99:t_1:19.en:
$$オットー$$
「First, we'll descend to Japan. Now that the Empire has broken through 《$$新日本$$》, that area will become a battlefield too.」

99:t_1:26.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Are you thinking about $$シンジ$$ and the others?」

99:t_1:28.en:
$n
「If we'd been stronger, could we have saved $$シンジ$$ and $$レイ#pt394$$...?」

99:t_1:29.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I wonder... I feel that was already beyond human understanding.」

99:t_1:30.en:
$n
「...Was watching them go really all we could do...?」

99:t_1:31.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It was the only thing we could do then.」

99:t_1:33.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't blame yourself, $n. It wasn't anyone's fault.」

99:t_1:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Of course, it wasn't $$シンジ$$'s fault either, even though he was at the center of it.」

99:t_1:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Get your head back in the game. We could be in combat at any moment.」

99:t_1:37.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「Will we be fighting the $$新地球皇国$$?」

99:t_1:38.en:
$$アムロ$$
「No... If anyone comes, it'll be $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

99:t_1:40.en:
$$アムロ$$
「As you know, the $$新地球皇国$$ rules only Earth. They've left the colonies alone.」

99:t_1:41.en:
$$エマ$$
「Is that because their goal is to lay down $$レイライン$$ and draw $$次元力|lc$$ from Earth?」

99:t_1:43.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What matters is what's happening now, rather than the reason. Some of Earth's people are trying to move to the colonies to escape the Empire's rule.」

99:t_1:44.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is $$ネオ・ジオン$$ taking them in?」

99:t_1:45.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...That alone wouldn't be a problem.」

99:t_1:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「While the Federation exhausted itself fighting the Empire, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ built up its personnel. That will set things in motion again.」

99:t_1:47.en:
$$カツ$$
「Don't tell me those bastards... plan to use this chance to attack Earth...!」

99:t_1:48.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「They can't...! The invaders already control most of Earth...!」

99:t_1:49.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We still don't know much about $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s situation. $$ブライト$$ has $$ロンド・ベル$$ on the move, but little information is coming in.」

99:t_1:50.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I hear Colonel $$シャア$$ returned to the colonies to check the situation. Hasn't any information come from him?」

99:t_1:52.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「He couldn't be doing it again...」

99:t_1:53.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You don't need to worry about that, $$ハサウェイ$$. He'll never go back to being $$ジオン$$'s $$赤い彗星$$.」

99:t_1:55.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「If you two say so, I can rest easy.」

99:t_1:56.en:
$$ファ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$ is $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s current leader, right?」

99:t_1:58.en:
$$カツ$$
「That woman saw the $$地球連邦$$ as her enemy. She might intend to crush the exhausted Federation completely.」

99:t_1:59.en:
$$エマ$$
「But descending to Earth would mean clashing with the Empire.」

99:t_1:60.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$ハマーン$$ isn't a fool. I can't imagine she'd take on both the Empire and the Federation in this situation.」

99:t_1:61.en:
$$フォウ$$
「You think pretty highly of $$ハマーン・カーン$$, don't you?」

99:t_1:62.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...Maybe I just want to believe in her.」

99:t_1:63.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and Earth probably won't fight together, either. There are reports of $$ネオ・ジオン$$ attacking $$連邦軍$$ sent to investigate the colonies.」

99:t_1:64.en:
$$カツ$$
「What the hell does $$ジオン$$ want to do...!?」

99:t_1:67.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Are you sensing that man's presence?」

99:t_1:69.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But I feel this baffling situation resembles the atmosphere surrounding him.」

99:t_1:70.en:
$n
「Are you saying $$ネオ・ジオン$$ is acting on $$フル・フロンタル$$'s wishes?」

99:t_1:71.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's true that his reasoning was unusual, but...」

99:t_1:72.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バナージ$$ is the only one who's met and spoken with that man in person. There may be something only $$バナージ$$ can sense.」

99:t_1:73.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I also think we need to watch out for $$ネオ・ジオン$$. This sector is in their sphere of influence too.」

99:t_1:74.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If we keep going, we'll find out how $$ネオ・ジオン$$ intends to act.」

99:t_1:77.en:
$$カツ$$
「Is it the $$新地球皇国$$...!? Or is it $$ネオ・ジオン$$...!?」

99:t_1:81.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$バナージ$$ is sensing him after all...)

99:t_1:82.en:
$$アムロ$$
(If so, what are you after in this situation, $$フル・フロンタル$$...?)

99:t_2:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You seem displeased that I've come to the front lines, Captain $$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$.」

kept_omissions: 99:t_1:7: Conditional deliberately trails off; Otto supplies possible destruction in the next row.
99:t_1:71: Suzune trails off on but before Amuro responds.
